nphi.title: Building Stronger Public Health Institutions and Systems (BIS), Phase 2
nphi.summary: Norad-funded programme to strengthen public health institutes in four core partner countries, with selected BIS-1 activities continuing in Uganda and Ghana. Themes are climate and health, digital health, infectious diseases, NCDs and…

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 110 – One Health Secure
nphi.with: Istituto Superiore di Sanità (ISS); CSIC; IRD; IZS Teramo; AVIA-GIS
nphi.summary: EU CBRN Centres of Excellence project in which Institut Pasteur and Italy's ISS, with veterinary and research partners, help Mediterranean, Black Sea and Sahel countries prepare for climate-sensitive vector-borne diseases through One…

nphi.title: BIS collaboration in Palestine
nphi.with: Palestinian National Institute of Public Health; Palestinian Ministry of Health; WHO country office; University of Oslo
nphi.summary: More than a decade of support to build PNIPH into a sustainable national institute. Work covers surveillance, registries, the MCH eRegistry and IHR core capacities.

nphi.title: NIPH global health security partner countries
nphi.with: WHO; IANPHI; Africa CDC; ECDC; US CDC
nphi.summary: NIPH lists Malawi, Moldova and Palestine (besides Ghana) as partner countries for IHR capacity, national public health institute strengthening and emergency preparedness.

nphi.title: 7-1-7 target and Early Action Review training of trainers for Palestine
nphi.summary: National training of trainers in Amman (September 2026) with the Palestinian Ministry of Health on the 7-1-7 timeliness target and early action reviews, starting an initial Palestinian 7-1-7 implementation plan.

nphi.title: GOARN Berlin Fellowship Programme (2025 cohort)
nphi.with: WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence; GOARN; Zambia National Public Health Institute; Palestinian National Institute of Public Health; Namibia MoHSS; Tanzania MoH
nphi.summary: RKI, the WHO Hub and GOARN host a six-month fellowship in Berlin and Geneva; the 2025 fellows came from Namibia, Zambia (ZNPHI), Palestine (PNIPH) and Tanzania.

nphi.title: EU Initiative on Health Security (2020–2025)
nphi.with: National public health institutes and ministries of health of EU Enlargement and Neighbourhood countries
nphi.summary: DG NEAR-funded €9 million programme through which ECDC built epidemic intelligence, risk assessment, preparedness and field-epidemiology (MediPIET) capacity in 21 neighbourhood and enlargement countries and integrated them into ECDC…

nphi.title: GOARN in the Eastern Mediterranean: partner institutions and 2019-2020 deployments
nphi.actor: GOARN Eastern Mediterranean partner institutions (incl. NIH Pakistan, Institut Pasteur Tunis, EMPHNET)
nphi.with: National Institute of Health Pakistan; Institut Pasteur du Maroc; Institut Pasteur de Tunis; Institut Pasteur of Iran; EMPHNET; Ministries of Health
nphi.summary: 17 partner institutions from 12 countries support outbreak deployments, e.g. 25 experts to the Larkana HIV outbreak in Pakistan, cholera in Yemen, floods in Iran and measles in Tunisia (2019-2020).

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 075 – MediLabSecure (One Health biological risks in the Mediterranean, Black Sea and Sahel)
nphi.with: Istituto Superiore di Sanità (ISS); IRD; INIA; IZS Teramo; Avia-GIS
nphi.summary: EU-funded network led by Institut Pasteur with Italy's ISS that strengthened laboratories and public health institutions in 22 neighbouring countries to detect and respond to arboviruses and their vectors, including external quality…

nphi.title: MediPIET – Mediterranean and Black Sea Programme for Intervention Epidemiology Training
nphi.with: FIIAPP; FCSAI; ECDC (scientific lead); national public health authorities of partner countries
nphi.summary: An EU-initiated field epidemiology fellowship for Mediterranean and Black Sea countries. ISCIII co-implemented it with FIIAPP (2014–2017) and FCSAI (2018–2021); ECDC ran it alone from 2021 to 2025.

nphi.title: Workshop for field epidemiology officials from Asian countries (CFETP, MOFCOM-funded)
nphi.actor: China CDC (China Field Epidemiology Training Program)
nphi.with: NHFPC International Exchange and Cooperation Center; Ministry of Commerce (aid training)
nphi.summary: CFETP hosted a three-week aid-funded workshop in Beijing for 20 field epidemiology officials from seven Asian countries. It was the second such workshop for Asian countries, and a 2015 round followed.

nphi.title: Establishing the Palestinian National Public Health Institute (WHO–Norway project)
nphi.with: WHO; Palestinian Ministry of Health; Norwegian Representative Office (funder)
nphi.summary: A Norway-funded, WHO-managed project with NIPH and the Palestinian Ministry of Health laid the groundwork for a national public health institute in Ramallah (NOK 23 million).
